description: A modern .NET library for managing RTL-SDR devices with support for async operations, multiple tuner types, and advanced features.
releaseNotes:
v0.8.0 (2026-08-25):

            ADDED:
            - SupportedFrequencyRanges on RtlSdrManagedDevice, with the TunerCapabilities,
              DemodulatorCapabilities and FrequencyRange types behind it, reporting what the
              device can currently reach: the tuner's ranges, or the ADC's while direct
              sampling is active.
            - OpenManagedDeviceBySerial(), opening a device by serial number rather than by
              index. Indices are positional and shift when devices are plugged or unplugged;
              a serial stays with the device. Throws if several devices share the serial.
            - TransferBufferCount, controlling how many buffers the device fills in rotation
              during an asynchronous reading. Trades tolerance of a slow consumer against
              worst-case latency; previously fixed at 15 and unreachable.

            FIXED:
            - Direct sampling is usable at last. CenterFrequency validated against the tuner's
              range even while direct sampling bypassed the tuner, so every HF frequency was
              rejected. The range is now the ADC's: 0 Hz to half the crystal frequency.
            - The E4000 accepts exactly 1100 and 1250 MHz, which an asymmetric comparison
              rejected even though both are documented as supported.
            - 0.0 dB is accepted as a tuner gain on the R820T/R828D, where it is the tuner's
              lowest gain step. It was treated as an error value, so SupportedTunerGains
              reported 28 of 29 gains and TunerGain = 0.0 threw.
            - SetMaximumTunerGain()/SetMinimumTunerGain() on a tuner without manual gain
              control now name the cause, instead of throwing "Sequence contains no elements".
            - SetBiasTeeGPIO() works on every tuner, not just the R820T. The GPIO pins belong
              to the demodulator, so the restriction was never justified.

            CHANGED:
            - BREAKING: using a disposed device now throws ObjectDisposedException. Most
              importantly, StartReadSamplesAsync() on a disposed device terminated the process;
              configuring one, resetting the dropped-sample counter and StopReadSamplesAsync()
              succeeded silently. A disposed device can still be inspected: DeviceInfo,
              ToString(), AsyncReadException, DroppedSamplesCount and the configuration
              getters keep working.
            - BREAKING: reading TunerGain, CenterFrequency or SampleRate before one has been
              set throws InvalidOperationException instead of RtlSdrLibraryExecutionException.
              All three reported a device failure for what is a usage error.
            - Enabling direct sampling resets the center frequency to 0 Hz when the current one
              is beyond the ADC's reach, because the demodulator would truncate it silently.
            - BREAKING: SetBiasTeeGPIO() throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a pin outside
              0..7, instead of RtlSdrLibraryExecutionException.
            - BREAKING: RtlSdrDeviceManager.Devices is now IReadOnlyDictionary, so the device
              table can no longer be mutated by callers. Reading and enumeration unchanged.
            - BREAKING: StartReadSamplesAsync() caps a single read at 8388608 samples (16 MiB)
              and the total across all transfer buffers at 256 MiB. The old limit allowed a
              ~4 GB request, allocated once per buffer, failing with no useful diagnostic.
            - SetMinimumTunerGain() selects 0.0 dB on the R820T/R828D instead of 0.9 dB.
            - The E4000's 1100 to 1250 MHz gap is no longer rejected up front: its boundaries
              vary between devices, so the tuner decides and reports the outcome.

            KNOWN LIMITATION:
            - On macOS, starting a second asynchronous reading in the same process can fault
              inside the USB layer. Close the device and open it again between readings.
              Streaming once per device is unaffected, as is ReadSamples(), and as is
              retuning while a reading is running.

            See CHANGELOG.md for complete details and previous releases.
title: RTL-SDR Manager for .NET
